title: Emarat, Dell Technologies collaborate to accelerate AI-enabled transformation and build future-ready capabilities
summary: The collaboration supports Emarat’s wider transformation agenda by identifying practical AI use cases

contentHtml:
The MoU was signed by Burhan Al Hashemi, Chief Executive Officer of Emarat, and Walid Yehia, Managing Director, South Gulf, Dell Technologies. Image Courtesy: Emarat

The collaboration supports Emarat’s wider transformation agenda by identifying practical AI use cases

Press Release

Dubai, UAE: Emirates Petroleum Company P.J.S.C. (Emarat), a leading integrated energy company in the UAE, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Dell Technologies to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced digital technologies. The collaboration supports Emarat’s wider transformation agenda by identifying practical AI use cases, strengthening data-driven decision-making, and building scalable technology capabilities that enhance operational efficiency, resilience and sustainable growth.

The MoU was signed by Burhan Al Hashemi, Chief Executive Officer of Emarat, and Walid Yehia, Managing Director, South Gulf, Dell Technologies. Under the agreement, both organisations will jointly identify opportunities to apply AI-enabled technologies across key areas of Emarat’s business, assess evolving technology requirements, and develop a roadmap aligned with Emarat’s long-term priorities.

The collaboration will also focus on building AI capabilities across Emarat through tailored multilevel workshops for employees aimed at strengthening their understanding of AI and its practical applications in the workplace. The sessions will support organisation-wide capability-building and equip teams with the knowledge and skills needed to contribute to Emarat’s ongoing transformation into a more agile, data-driven enterprise.

Burhan Al Hashemi, Chief Executive Officer of Emarat, said, “At Emarat, we see every strategic collaboration as an important contributor to our wider transformation journey. By working with leading partners such as Dell Technologies, we are bringing together the expertise, capabilities and technologies needed to strengthen our business, elevate performance and create lasting value. This reflects our commitment to building a more advanced, competitive and future-ready economy.”  

Walid Yehia, Managing Director, South Gulf, Dell Technologies, said, “AI is creating new opportunities for organizations to reimagine how they operate, engage customers and deliver value. By bringing together advanced infrastructure, cloud capabilities and AI-enabled technologies, this collaboration establishes a strong foundation for scalable innovation and supports Emarat’s vision of building a digitally empowered economy.”  

The MoU further forms part of Emarat’s broader transformation agenda, which focuses on enhancing technology capabilities, strengthening operational resilience and building strategic partnerships that support sustainable growth and long-term value creation.

About Emarat

Established in 1980, Emirates General Petroleum Corporation, Emarat, is a national public joint stock company (PJSC) and one of the leading companies in the energy and fuel services sector in the UAE. Since its establishment as a federal government corporation, Emarat has continued to play a key role in supporting the country’s needs through an integrated network of service stations, energy products and solutions, and retail and vehicle services.

The company’s operations include the supply of various types of fuel, lubricants, liquefied petroleum gas, and aviation fuel through Emojet, in addition to a comprehensive range of vehicle and retail services.

Emarat’s portfolio includes a number of brands and services, including Freshplus, Bakeria, Café Arabicca, Shamil, Fasttrack, and the EmCan loyalty programme.

For more information, please visit: http://www.emarat.ae
